title: Pricing page update live on the 13th
transcript:
[00:00] Elena: Pricing page. The new prices take effect on the 13th, so the page has to match by then.
[00:08] Jun: The 13th is a Friday, right?
[00:11] Elena: Yes.
[00:13] Marisol: Sales already sent the existing customers their notice, so that side is covered.
[00:21] Jun: OK. What changes on the page?
[00:25] Elena: The pricing update. Starter goes from twelve to fifteen, Team from twenty-nine to thirty-two.
[00:36] Jun: And enterprise stays as contact us?
[00:39] Elena: Yes.
[00:41] Marisol: Customers keep asking about annual billing, so the timing is good.
[00:48] Jun: Agreed. I'll build the pricing update on a branch and send you a preview link on Monday.
[00:57] Elena: Great. So the pricing update is live on the 13th, Jun owns it.
[01:03] Jun: Yep, live on the 13th.
[01:06] Marisol: Perfect. I'll update the sales deck to match.
[01:11] Elena: Do we need to change the FAQ?
[01:14] Marisol: The FAQ still says prices are locked for a year. That's no longer true for monthly plans.
[01:23] Elena: Then I'll rewrite that answer.
[01:26] Jun: Send me the new copy and I'll swap it in.
[01:30] Elena: Will do. Anything else?
[01:33] Marisol: Only that the sales team will want to link straight to the page from proposals.
[01:40] Jun: The URL won't change, so old links keep working.
[01:45] Marisol: Good. That's it, then.
